meta.title: Error Atlas
meta.description: Records runtime errors and coding-task retrospectives, links each lesson back to the failures it came from, groups errors under the program directory a task touched, searches the graph by error, tool, program or session, charts failure activity over the last 24 hours and 30 days, reports truncated or muted signatures honestly, and opens the source session from any node; renders everything as an interactive GPU knowledge graph and exports Markdown. The panel copy follows the DSH language setting (Chinese / English). Lessons are injected into the model context and queryable through the atlas_lessons tool. A collapsible lesson-effectiveness board ranks tags and programs by failure rate. Two memory switches in the panel turn the reminder and the injected lessons off instantly
